name: gh skill (GitHub CLI)
summary: GitHub CLI command group to search, preview, install, list, update and publish agent skills from GitHub repositories (preview).
description: Subcommands: install, list, preview, publish, search, update (alias `gh skills`). Example: `gh skill install github/awesome-copilot documentation-writer`; `gh skill publish --dry-run` validates skills for publishing. Marked preview and subject to change.
